annotations.name: FeltKit release check (CI mode)
annotations.condition: @feltdb/feltkit's runtime dependencies are exact pins resolved at their pin; @feltdb/core and @appport/services are '>=floor <ceiling' ranges resolved inside the range; the lockfile's @appport/services integrity matches npm; one @feltdb/core copy. Being behind npm's latest for the floating packages is only reported in CI (FELTKIT_RELEASE_CHECK_LATEST=report).

annotations.name: FeltKit publish gate (strict)
annotations.condition: Everything the CI release check enforces, plus: @feltdb/core and @appport/services must be npm's latest release (strict), and every runtime dependency must be published at its pin or inside its range (release gate).
annotations.note: scripts/publish-packages.mjs runs test:release without FELTKIT_RELEASE_CHECK_LATEST, then release:gate. Read at rkendel1/feltkit@65744b3.
